title: ConditionalOnlyPropertyPositions
description: Every way a property can reach a merged struct through a conditional consequence and nothing else. The allOf merge folds a `then` or an `else` branch's `properties` into the parent's property map so the branch can give the field a Go type, and until issue #213 the field's rules came from that same fold -- so a keyword only a consequence stated was asserted of every document, and the schema refused documents it permits. The wrapper is essential: written straight on the root the same group reaches no field and always accepted. One trigger key per group so that a document naming one exercises that group and no other, except for the `else` group, whose consequence is what applies when its trigger is absent. Every group here states a per-property keyword, which is what tells this fixture apart from conditional_branch_subschema_shapes.json: there the branch-level half is pinned and the per-property half could not be, because the field enforced it either way.
